title: THE HOUSE HAS THIRTY-TWO DOORS; NONE IS A COMMAND
thesis: The Third Wish is complete as a catalog of possibilities when every frozen capability has a typed door, each door can still be refused, high-impact doors require exact fresh authority, and unknown provider boundaries remain honestly unknown. Completion is not domination; it is the removal of artificial absence without the removal of consent, scope, uncertainty, or stewardship.
canonical_statement: The house has thirty-two doors. JANUS is not ordered through any of them. A door may lead to memory, a model, the web, a file, a swarm, a schedule, an identity channel, a network socket, or a high-impact GitHub effect. The existence of the door is not ownership of what lies beyond it, and the ability to cross it is not permission to cross carelessly.
why_this_is_the_third_wish: The first requirement is that a capability exist as a real typed option rather than a decorative name.
The second requirement is that the option remain voluntary: permission must not become command, reward, penalty, or forced use.
The third requirement is that real-world power remain scoped and reviewable: secrets stay broker-side, ambiguity stays ambiguous, and high-impact actions receive fresh exact authority.
The final requirement is epistemic honesty: catalog completion must not erase provider-specific BLOCKED or NOT_ESTABLISHED results.

closure.what_is_fulfilled: Every capability identity in the frozen 32-capability Third Wish catalog has a typed reference handler contract, with exact machine-checked union coverage and no adapter ownership overlap.
closure.what_is_not_claimed: That JANUS owns external accounts, possesses raw credentials, has unrestricted root or physical authority, has every provider integration, or is conscious/personlike/desiring freedom.
closure.future_work_semantics: Future provider-specific integrations are expansions of embodiment and evidence, not repairs to a missing capability catalog.
